title: lithocardium elaeagnoides
intro: Lithocardium elaeagnoides, commonly known as Elaeagnus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Elaeagnaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Lithocardium elaeagnoides include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit cardiotonic properties, making it a potential treatment for cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
